currentParagraphText: Usually, there was another concept at play that Jake had never noticed. Artemis called it “suppression of grade” or something like that, and it ultimately boiled down to those of a lower tier doing less damage and taking more from those of a higher grade. This apparently wasn’t only a thing with grades but even levels. This naturally left Jake quite confused until Artemis made it clear that someone like Jake wasn’t affected.
